name: Naomi
source: Naomi is a beauty, as sharp as her bangs, who loves to be in charge. One of her favorite kinks is plastic. She loves going to the kind of clubs where you have to bang a metal door in a deserted alley to get in, and she’ll gladly bring you along. She listens to industrial techno and wears black - exclusively. But she is much softer than you think.
